name: loopgain
description: An open-source cost controller for AI agent loops — stops a loop when it's actually converged and rolls back before it degrades, instead of running to a fixed max_iterations cap. Real-time loop-gain (Aβ) bands + best-so-far rollback. Adapters for LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, OpenAI Agents, and Claude Agent SDK; raw API for custom stacks.

paragraphs: An open-source cost controller for AI agent loops.

AI agent loops waste time and money when they don't know when to stop. LoopGain measures the loop in real time and stops it the moment it has actually converged — and rolls back before it degrades — instead of running to a fixed maxiterations cap.

Benchmark — 2,000 paired trials across 10 workload cells (run it yourself): - 92.8% less API spend than maxiter=20 — $27.05 → $1.94 in total benchmark spend - 15× faster — median wall-clock per trial 30.9s → 2.1s - Quality preserved, not traded for speed — judge win-rate 0.50–0.63 on natural-distribution workloads (W1–W4, CI excluding null on most cells), 0.92–0.95 on engineered-failure workloads (W5); 0.678 weighted preference across 1,800 judge comparisons - Zero of six kill criteria fired (all six pre-registered with thresholds before the run)

whatItDoes.text: An open-source cost controller for AI agent loops.
